name: Anchor
description: Describes the point an overlay positions itself against and tracks it while it moves.
notes: No <name>_style.dart / <name>_theme.dart: the component paints nothing; the only token read is the caller's.

There is no process-wide registry any more. `OverlayAnchor` asserts it sits under an `OverlayAnchorScope`, which is what lets sibling screens reuse the same anchor keys (the old `OverlayAnchorRegistry.global` collided).
`AnchorSubscription.dispose()` is part of the contract; the old doc claimed there was no dispose while a per-frame Ticker ran until one was called.
`deps.primitives` is empty although the batch data lists ["overlay"]: primitives/overlay.dart (OverlayHandler, OverlayBarrier, PopoverConstraint) is not used by this component.
preview.dart imports the `button` component; preview files are excluded from dependency checking.
